title: smoke-test chart values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on smoke-test config drift. Smoke test is a Job that asserts every Deployment/StatefulSet in declared namespaces is Ready + that critical endpoints respond. Misconfigured namespaces[] / endpoints[] = silent false-pass.

repository.description: Container image. B47 LIVE FIX: MUST bundle BOTH kubectl + curl (alpine/k8s default). bitnamilegacy/kubectl lacks curl = Phase 2 endpoint probes fail with 'command not found'.

items.description: K8s namespace name (RFC 1123 DNS label). Empty array = no Phase 1 check = silent false-pass.

namespaces.description: Namespaces to scan for Deployment/StatefulSet readiness. At least one required.

name.description: Human-readable endpoint identifier (used in test output).

url.description: Cluster-internal service URL (http://<svc>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local:<port>/path). Anchored pattern catches typo + uppercase hostnames + non-numeric ports.

endpoints.description: HTTP endpoints to probe in Phase 2.
